title: NovoPen scanning inconsistent uploading to Nightscout
body:
### Your environment
- What version of xDrip: 3e86af7-2023.11.14
- What type of hardware data source and how do you get your data there: Dex Share Follower

### Expected behavior
All treatments scanned from the NovoPen should be uploaded from xDrip to nightscout via the REST API but this happens inconsistently 

### Actual behavior
Normally when I scan my NovoPen the treatments are uploaded to Nightscout in <30 seconds via the REST API, however, there is inconsistently in this, sometimes records do not upload to Nightscout via the REST API. The Nightscout instance is a Digital Ocean droplet with firewall rules configured to only allow HTTP and HTTPS traffic through Cloudflare.
https://www.cloudflare.com/en-gb/ips/

I initially thought this could be caused by firewall rules on Cloudflare but there's nothing being blocked as I allow all traffic in the UK to be whitelisted as I have some displays that fetch data from Nightscout and this simply avoids the issue of manually whitelisting other attributes.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
For example:
1. Enable the insulin pen scanning like so.
![image](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/62076535/1cb0084d-da3a-4fb0-ae84-84a2640269bd)
2. Configure the RESTI API in the Cloud Upload section with a valid API token to allow uploading of treatment data.
3. 
![image](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/62076535/20b2a057-69be-4dd6-89e5-16cc1421cd48)
![image](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/62076535/2e36e6cd-68fe-4f18-a2c5-ace14cf58967)
4. Tap NovoPen to the back of the phone until the treatments display on xDrip
5. Wait a few minutes at max and see no record being uploaded to my Nightscout instance like so. 
![image](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/62076535/53c6d927-5f16-4e41-81a8-053f2596729c)
![image](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/assets/62076535/af38b573-3611-4480-b1a5-891343197f7d)


As you can see from the screenshots the data is not reflecting what's uploaded to Nightscout.
